news.title_ru: Вероятность снижения ставки ФРС снизилась, поскольку ставки на сентябрьское повышение в Калши достигли 60–68%

news.title: MicroStrategy Resumes Bitcoin Accumulation After Extended Buying Gap
news.body: Strategy resumes Bitcoin purchases after 10 weeks, adding 4,603 BTC and bringing its reported holdings to 845,050 BTC. The post MicroStrategy Resumes Bitcoin Accumulation After Extended Buying Gap appeared first on 99Bitcoins.
